exercises.title: Spinner y badge animados
exercises.prompt:
Crea dos animaciones con `@keyframes`:

1. `@keyframes girar`: de `rotate(0deg)` a `rotate(360deg)`.
2. `@keyframes pulsar`: `0%` scale(1), `50%` scale(1.2), `100%` scale(1).

Aplica:
- `.spinner` (width/height 48px, border 4px solid #E2E8F0, border-top-color #3B82F6, border-radius 50%): `animation: girar 1s linear infinite`
- `.badge-pulso` (width/height 12px, background #EF4444, border-radius 50%): `animation: pulsar 1.5s ease-in-out infinite`

tests.expression: Array.from(doc.styleSheets).some(ss => { try { return Array.from(ss.cssRules).some(r => r.type === 7 && r.name === 'girar'); } catch(e) { return false; } })
Array.from(doc.styleSheets).some(ss => { try { return Array.from(ss.cssRules).some(r => r.type === 7 && r.name === 'pulsar'); } catch(e) { return false; } })

Array.from(doc.styleSheets).some(ss => { try { return Array.from(ss.cssRules).some(r => r.selectorText === '.spinner' && (r.style.animationName === 'girar' || r.style.animation.includes('girar'))); } catch(e) { return false; } })

Array.from(doc.styleSheets).some(ss => { try { return Array.from(ss.cssRules).some(r => r.selectorText === '.badge-pulso' && (r.style.animationName === 'pulsar' || r.style.animation.includes('pulsar'))); } catch(e) { return false; } })

hints: Define los @keyframes ANTES de usarlos, aunque CSS no lo requiere estrictamente.
`animation: girar 1s linear infinite` es el shorthand de name + duration + timing + iteration.
El tipo de CSSRule para @keyframes es 7 (CSSRule.KEYFRAMES_RULE).
